props.Notes:
PODYAP WEEKLY READINESS FLOW (internal operating record)

PURPOSE
Confirm whether the week's Podyap work is ready, owned, and moving, without Monny chasing the team. Internal preparation only. This record sends nothing.

SCHEDULE (documented only)
- Sunday 9:00 AM PT: check whether an active Podyap episode exists for the next seven days. If none exists, remain silent.
- Sunday 6:00 PM PT: reply-by deadline for the readiness prompt.
- Monday 9:00 AM PT: if all required fields are confirmed, remain silent. If fields are missing, one conditional nudge names only the missing fields. Documented only. Never sent automatically.

STATES
- READY: all required fields for the current production stage are confirmed.
- WAITING: the Sunday prompt was sent and replies are pending.
- BLOCKED: Monday's nudge was sent and required fields remain missing. A sent nudge is not completion.
- DONE: the week's defined production milestone was completed.
- PARKED: no Podyap work is active this week.

REQUIRED FIELDS (one accountable owner each)
- Episode, title or working title. Owner: Monny.
- Weekly state: planning, recording, editing, scheduled, released, or blocked. Owner: Sunshine.
- Topic owner: Monny.
- Production owner: Sunshine.
- Equipment owner, when recording is scheduled: Omar.
- Segment or episode arc, one sentence: Sunshine.
- Recording date, verified date or not scheduled: Sunshine.
- Release date, verified date or not scheduled: Sunshine.
- Blocker, one sentence or none: Sunshine.
- Help needed from Monny, one decision or none: Monny.

STOPPING POINT
The flow stops when the episode is READY, the milestone is DONE, the episode is PARKED, or one Monday nudge has been sent and the flow is BLOCKED.

AUTOMATION STATE
Record: GENERATED. Schedule: PLANNED. Nothing is SCHEDULED. Nothing has been SENT.

REMAINING GAPS
- Recurring team sends are NOT NOW (Monny, 2026-09-28). The L3 recurring authorization record is not created. Required before any send: exact recipients, owning lane, approved purpose, approved template, allowed variable fields, send schedule, quiet hours, start date, expiration or review date, maximum reminder count, revocation command ("STOP PODYAP CHECK"), canonical authorization record, per-send receipts.
- No PROGRAMS database exists in the OS and no Podyap program record was found to link. Link one here if created later. Scope not widened.
- Linked CONTENT: Podyap episode plotted for 2026-10-07 ("What did care sound like before we called it wellness?", Status Draft). CONCEPT-ONLY, no recording mapped (Monny, 2026-09-28). Do not attach an older episode.

Completed 12-week container. What the water taught us: naming an end date is what made the commitment possible — people said yes to twelve weeks precisely because it was not forever.
